name: esphome-display-editor
description: Connect Claude Desktop to the ESPHome Display Editor MCP server.
long_description: A local stdio bridge for the ESPHome Display Editor's authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Claude can inspect projects and ESPHome YAML, place widgets, create bindings, review deterministic previews, and propose revision-checked change sets according to the scopes of the selected client token. The extension does not contain the editor server and requires a reachable Home Assistant app instance.

mcp_url.title: MCP server URL
mcp_url.description: The LAN Streamable HTTP endpoint, for example http://homeassistant.local:8100/mcp.

mcp_token.title: MCP client token
mcp_token.description: Create a scoped, expiring token on the editor's System page. The value is stored as a sensitive setting by Claude Desktop.
